snippet.title: ROOM XIII – Official Demo - First Look Gameplay (No Spoilers)
snippet.description:
An unexpected call leads Father Joseph to an old countryside hotel, at the desperate request of an old friend. Something strange is happening in that place. Echoes of the past seem unwilling to fade.
Alone, and with his faith put to the test, Joseph must face a presence that refuses to be ignored.

ROOM XIII is a psychological horror game where every door draws Father Joseph deeper into a cycle of haunting and memory. Trapped in an old hotel scarred by tragedy, he must confront manifestations that test both his faith and his sanity. 

This demo offers around 15 to 30 minutes of gameplay, depending on your pace and how you explore the environment.

🎙️ Languages available:

Voice acting: English and Brazilian Portuguese

Subtitles: English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish

This project is being created entirely by me — I’m developing everything on my own: programming, art, design, writing, and atmosphere. What you’re watching here is not the final demo; it’s just a small taste of the experience. There are still plenty of bugs and rough edges, and I’ll keep improving the game step by step.

If you enjoy the concept and want to see ROOM XIII reach more players, any support makes a huge difference — especially to help cover the $100 Steam fee required to publish the game there.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support truly keeps this project alive!
